info.title: AgentCargo Registry API
info.description: Anonymous read operations plus authenticated release reservation, digest-bound artifact upload, and scanning completion for immutable AgentCargo skill releases.

302.description: Redirects the browser to GitHub's authorization page
Redirects to the configured application path and sets an HttpOnly session cookie

post.summary: Exchange a GitHub bearer credential for an AgentCargo session
post.description: Exchanges a provider-verified GitHub bearer credential for a short-lived AgentCargo bearer session. The response is never cacheable.

get.description: Validates a short-lived AgentCargo bearer session and returns token-free expiry and scope metadata. The response is never cacheable.

200.description: Token-free metadata for the active AgentCargo session

get.description: Returns sanitized API, database, artifact-storage, scan-worker, and moderation signals. It contains no package contents, credentials, or internal error details.
Returns namespaces, packages, and immutable release histories owned by the authenticated publisher. Requires publisher:read and is never cacheable.

200.description: The authenticated publisher's package and version history

post.summary: Submit an authenticated package or release report
post.description: Creates a bounded abuse report and an append-only report_created moderation audit event. Replays with the same reporter and idempotency key are safe.

get.description: Maintainer-only, no-store audit history. Event metadata is bounded and excludes report evidence, tokens, and package contents.

post.description: Requires publisher:write and namespace ownership. The release remains addressable as deprecated; the coordinate and artifact identity stay immutable.
Maintainer-only emergency control. Quarantined releases are excluded from anonymous package, search, and exact-release reads while their immutable history remains auditable.
Maintainer-only restoration. The release returns to its pre-quarantine public status and emits a new append-only moderation event.

get.description: Returns only active SHA-256 blocks and bounded remediation reasons. Clients should fail closed if this endpoint is unavailable before installing a release.

post.summary: Add or remove an emergency digest block
post.description: Maintainer-only, idempotent emergency control. Every add/remove emits an append-only moderation audit event targeting the artifact digest.

200.description: Immutable release metadata and a request-scoped artifact URL

Cache-Control.description: May be cached according to the URL expiry; release identity is immutable.

post.description: Requires an authenticated publisher context. The current API implementation keeps this route unavailable until authentication, namespace authorization, and durable reservation persistence are configured.

200.description: An idempotent replay of an existing reservation

post.summary: Create a signed upload URL for a reserved release

201.description: A newly created signed upload URL

200.description: An idempotent replay of an upload URL request

post.summary: Complete an uploaded release and mark it for scanning

202.description: The uploaded release is queued for scanning

200.description: An idempotent replay of release completion

NotFound.description: The package or release does not exist publicly

Quarantined.description: The release is quarantined and cannot be installed through the public read path

RateLimited.description: The anonymous read rate limit was exceeded

Unauthorized.description: A valid authenticated publisher context is required

Forbidden.description: The authenticated session does not contain the required registry scope

Conflict.description: The idempotency key or release coordinate conflicts with an existing reservation

NotConfigured.description: Authenticated publishing is not configured on this registry instance

AuthNotConfigured.description: Hosted authentication is not configured on this registry instance

ServiceUnavailable.description: The identity provider or registry is temporarily unavailable

InternalError.description: The registry returned an invalid operational response
